name: Pressed Cream
promptName: Frosted Glass Cream Jar with Brass Lid
legacyNames: Frosted Glass Cream Jar with Brass Lid
description: A squat, wide frosted-glass jar with straight vertical walls, closed with a flat brushed-brass lid and wrapped with a plain matte stone-grey paper band, sized for a dense pressed face cream.
materials: Acid-etched frosted glass jar, brushed brass lid, matte-coated stone-grey paper wraparound band left blank and unprinted
primaryColors: Milky frosted white-grey glass, warm brushed brass, soft stone-grey band
negativeConstraints: Never render any text, wordmark, logo, printing, embossing, or engraving anywhere on the glass, lid, or band; never add a second lid or a pump/dropper mechanism; never make the glass fully transparent, it must stay translucent frosted glass; no props, hands, or presenter in frame. Exception: a mark, wordmark, or label that the brief's art direction explicitly names is deliberate and must be rendered exactly as directed — the text bans above apply only to invented marks the art direction never asked for.
preservationNotes: Keep the jar squat and wide with straight vertical walls and a flat (never domed or ridged) brushed-brass lid, and keep the band's plain stone-grey paper tone and blank surface identical in shape, proportion, and material across every angle. When the art direction explicitly names a mark on this product, that named mark is part of the product's identity for that shot and overrides the blank-surface requirement.
